name: Lagueruela (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow-edged vesica (eye shape) at the hoist bearing a yellow tower, and two green discs edged yellow at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Lagueruela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: eye-shaped vesica outline at the hoist
two discs edged yellow at the fly
